title: Grounding Reframe Extension — Fire on Significant Snapshot Findings with In-Cycle Course-Correction Implications
summary: Extends ADR-059's Grounding Reframe to fire in a second situation: when a susceptibility snapshot returns a finding that is specific, actionable, and applicable at the current phase boundary, not only when sycophancy risk is unassessable. The protocol body is unchanged — name what's uncertain, offer concrete grounding actions, make the cost of proceeding visible — only the trigger condition is broadened. Two Cycle 10 demonstrations (a DISCOVER per-entry pass correcting six flagged lines in product-discovery.md, and a MODEL belief-mapping check grounding the Invariant 8 commitment) are recorded as canonical examples calibrating what "significant" means.
workflow_point: phase boundaries, immediately after a susceptibility snapshot returns findings
mechanism: extended Grounding Reframe trigger (significant, actionable, in-cycle-applicable snapshot findings)

links.note: Extends ADR-059's Grounding Reframe trigger condition to also fire on significant susceptibility-snapshot findings with in-cycle course-correction implications, not only on unassessable sycophancy risk.

Couples to ADR-066's compound defense: ADR-066 specifies what the phase-boundary snapshot does, and this ADR specifies how the agent responds to the snapshot's significant findings via the extended Grounding Reframe.
